item.curious_mobs.sleight_of_hand.toolti:
Right-click any creature to open its inventory and curio slots:
freely view, take and place the items and curios it carries.
The magician's hand is quick and leaves no trace.
item.curious_mobs.request_and_demand.too:
Right-click any creature to transfer the curses of your cursed curios onto it,
or permanently purge your own curse effects (keeping the curios' positive bonuses).
Note: currently only the Seven Curses Ring's curses can be fully removed;
curses like the Catastrophe Scroll cannot be fully removed yet.
item.curious_mobs.devil_contract.tooltip:
Right-click a tamed or controlled creature to seal the contract:
stamps it with a servant mark recognizable by Goety,
keeping everything it gained from Mob Controller, and it will never vanish over time.

curious_mobs.config.title: Curious Mobs · Config
curious_mobs.config.transfer_curio_items:
When true, Curious Mobs moves the cursed curios onto the target's curio slots (like the Substitute Scarecrow).
When false, curios stay on the player and only the curse effects are permanently removed (keeping their bonuses).
